worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.summary: Spin the whole body to wind up, then bring the huge hammer down along a real track: only what the hammer head actually sweeps is hit. Overhead lands the head on a reachable support ahead and only after touchdown drives a three-step ground shockwave along the real surface, which walls and cliffs cut short; sweep carries the heavy hammer along a real horizontal arc at some cost to power and tempo. Recovery is long and the hammer cannot be raised again for a while, though using another move lets it recover early.
worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.use.0: Spin up and bring the huge hammer down along a real track
worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.use.1: Drive a three-step ground shockwave that advances along the real surface
worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.use.2: Sweep a real horizontal arc when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.descript: The hammer head falls along a real arc onto a support within %3$s blocks, and every target the head sweeps takes about %1$s physical damage; after touchdown a ground shockwave about %4$s blocks long is driven from the contact point along the real surface in three ordered steps, and every other foe it catches takes about %2$s physical damage. Both use Attack, wall and cliff cut the wave short, and each target takes only one of the two.
The shockwave has a %1$s-block half-width and shoves targets back %2$s blocks through native hit displacement, so a knockback-resistant body is still hurt but pushed less. Charge time: %3$s.
The shockwave advances %1$s blocks per tick along the real surface; the three ground ripples on screen follow the same real surface vertices at that pace.
After the slam it cannot be used again for %1$s; using any other move lets the hammer recover early.
worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.sweep.on: Sweep: circle the user within the actual hammer reach. Only the moving head segment hits; the inner gap is not struck by the handle. Power ×0.75, recovery +6 ticks, cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.sweep.of: Overhead style now: the head lands on a reachable support ahead and, after touchdown, drives a three-step ground shockwave at full power on the primary target.

worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.growth.1: From level %1$s the hammer is %2$s, the shockwave %3$s and its length %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.preferen: Sweep hits only along the real hammer-head path and stops at walls; power ×0.75, recovery +6 ticks, cooldown +8 ticks. Overhead starts three ground-wave sections only after real contact with legal support.
Beyond this distance it will not swing the hammer and closes in first.
Below this health fraction it will not swing unless the target is nearly down. Higher values make it more protective and less likely to finish a weakened foe.
On (with sweep style): it swings more readily when other enemies stand near the target, since the arc catches them all; off ranks by the single-target payoff only.
